name: Achilles Tendinopathy Rehabilitation Protocol
description: Evidence-based protocol for Achilles tendinopathy using isometric and heavy-slow resistance training
pain_rule: Pain max. 3/10 during the exercise. Pain must return to baseline within 24 hours.
evidence_base: JOSPT 2024 Achilles Tendinopathy Clinical Practice Guidelines
Systematic Reviews on Heavy-Slow Resistance Training
progression_criteria: Pain level acceptable (max. 3/10 during, resolves within 24h)
Sets/reps completed in 2 consecutive training sessions

exercises.name: Isometric Calf Raise
exercises.description: Standing on affected leg in partial plantarflexion position
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and initial tendon adaptation

exercises.name: Bilateral Heel Raises
exercises.description: Standing heel raises on both legs with controlled tempo
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength and load capacity

exercises.name: Single-Leg Heel Raises
exercises.description: Standing heel raises on one leg with controlled tempo and external weight
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength and load capacity

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Calf Raises
exercises.description: Targets the soleus muscle with knee flexed during calf raises
exercises.phase_goal: Increase tendon strength and load capacity
